source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 January 1925, p. 6 ("Urban councils: nominations in various Ulster towns")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation), nominations 5 January, poll Thursday 15 January 1925. Eleven members were returned unopposed and four wards (Court, Dock, Falls and Smithfield) were contested; the Socialists (Labour) gained Dock and Smithfield (Belfast News-Letter, 6 and 16 January 1925). M'Laurin was High Sheriff. Returned unopposed.
